blocks.text: Hydrocarbons natural taur par kai processes se bante hain, jaise paude (vegetation), jangal ki aag (wildfire), volcano aur seeps (zameen se tel ya gas ka risna). Anthropogenic (insanon ki) activities, jaise fossil fuels ka incomplete jalna, oil spills (samandar mein tel girna), aur factories aur gariyon ka emission (dhuan), bhi hydrocarbons ke sources hain. Automobiles (gariyan) hydrocarbons ka sab se bara source hain. Methane sab se aam hydrocarbon aur air pollutant hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrocarbons ke natural aur human sources, aur sab se aam hydrocarbon pollutant batayein.
blocks.explanation: Natural: paude, jangal ki aag, volcano aur tel ya gas ka natural seepage (risna). Human: fossil fuels ka incomplete jalna, oil spills, factories aur sab se barh kar gariyon ka dhuan. Sab se aam hydrocarbon methane hai.

items: Hydrocarbons: paude, wildfire, volcano, seeps (natural); incomplete jalna, oil spills, factories, gariyan (insani, sab se bara); methane sab se aam.
